course.description.source: A free social studies course with 24 lessons about history, geography, culture and civic life.
course.description.back: A free social studies course of 24 lessons about history, geography, culture and civic life.
course.description.note: "civic life" as ชีวิตพลเมือง (short, plain); alternative การเป็นพลเมือง. Check it reads naturally beside the school subject หน้าที่พลเมือง used for section 4.

sections.0.question.source: How have people, ideas, and events shaped the world we live in?
sections.0.question.back: How have people, ideas and events shaped the world we live in?
sections.0.question.note: "shaped" as หล่อหลอม (used in all three 'shape' sentences in this file). It is common in Thai school books but a little literary for a 10-year-old; a plainer option is ทำให้โลก...เป็นอย่างทุกวันนี้.

sections.0.description.source: Explore how people, ideas, inventions, movement, and trade have shaped the world.
sections.0.description.back: Explore how people, ideas, inventions, travel and trade have shaped the world.
sections.0.description.note: "movement" (of people) as การเดินทาง (travel); การย้ายถิ่น would narrow it to migration. Check which reads better.

sections.1.question.source: How do places shape people's lives, and how do people shape places?
sections.1.question.back: How do places shape people's lives, and how do people shape places?
sections.1.question.note: Kept the English parallel with หล่อหลอม twice. Check it is not stiff.

sections.1.description.source: Understand maps, places, resources, climate, cities, and the relationship between people and the environment.
sections.1.description.back: Understand maps, places, resources, climate, cities and the relationship between people and the environment.

sections.2.question.source: How do people create meaning, community, and belonging?
sections.2.question.back: How do people create meaning, communities and a sense of belonging?

sections.2.description.source: Learn how communities create meaning through language, traditions, art, everyday life, and shared experiences.
sections.2.description.back: Learn how communities create meaning through language, traditions, art, daily life and shared experiences.

sections.3.question.source: How do people make choices, use resources, and build fairer communities together?
sections.3.question.back: How do people make choices, use resources and together build fairer communities?

sections.3.description.source: Explore everyday economics, media literacy, and how youth can contribute to their communities.
sections.3.description.back: Explore everyday economics, media literacy and how youth can contribute to their own communities.
sections.3.description.note: "media literacy" as การรู้เท่าทันสื่อ, the usual Thai term (not in KEY_TERMS).

practiceOptions.3.source: I practised another way (quietly, with sign, or in writing)
practiceOptions.3.back: I practised another way (quietly, using sign language, or in writing)
